description: Land Acquisition - Karagahathenna, Ambanganga Korale D/S Division, Matale District - Amendment to the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1645/12 of 16.03.2010 by Wattala D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices about specific land parcels being acquired for public purposes, including descriptions of the land, extents, boundaries, claimants, and compensation procedures. The content falls squarely within the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it concerns land acquisitions, property ownership transfers, and land registration matters.
